symptom: Customers report that checkout orders are not completing as expected

report.summary: order-service calls payment-service at http://payment-service:9999/payments and gets ClosedChannelException in milliseconds, while payment-service shows no errors or restarts. The address/port order-service uses for payment-service looks wrong, so orders stay PAYMENT_PENDING.

evidence.why: Failing payment calls go to payment-service:9999 and fail in 2-8 ms, a connection-level failure rather than slowness.
Dossier shows order-service to payment-service client failures, absent in the previous window, while payment-service has zero errors and no restarts.
Runbook identifies a fast-failing connection with a URL differing from the payment-service address as a wrong base URL or port (configuration).
evidence.quote: payment-service down or wrong base URL or port

order-service is the entry point of the lab. It accepts orders, reserves their stock in inventory-service, stores them in PostgreSQL, takes them through payment in payment-service, and serves them back by id.

| Level | Message |

| INFO | `Order counts are readable again` |
